account.title: Add Monitor Account
account.name: Account Name
account.channelUrlHint: Supports @handle, UC channel ID, or full video/playlist URL
account.apiKeyHint: Select a saved API Key, or leave empty to use system default (configured in system settings)
account.webhookHintDefault: Leave empty to use global Webhook config
account.webhookHintTelegram: Telegram Bot Token must be filled in the dedicated field below
account.botTokenHint: Chat ID must be configured in global settings; leave empty to use global Bot Token
account.dingtalkSecretPlaceholder: Starts with SEC, same robot as current Webhook
account.dingtalkSecretHint: If the robot has sign verification enabled in DingTalk admin, fill in SEC; must be the same robot as account-level Webhook URL. Do not fill in if using global DingTalk Webhook only.
account.feishuModeHint: Markdown Card: code-assembled rich text card; Feishu Template: requires creating a card template in Feishu open platform
account.feishuTemplateIdHint: Card template ID created in Feishu multi-dimensional table or open platform
account.feishuScanTemplateIdPlaceholder: Scan confirm card template ID, e.g., $UUID$
account.feishuScanTemplateIdHint: Template ID sent when scan completes (no new videos)
account.enableProxyHint: Both auto-download and manual batch download will use the selected node
account.downloadModeHint: Decides when to use fixed proxy, when to fallback to dynamic proxy
account.downloadModeHelp: Prefer account fixed proxy, fallback to system dynamic proxy when unavailable
account.previewRoutingHint: Will not trigger download, only preview how this account will route in current mode
account.proxyPoolPlaceholder: — Enable proxy first, then select node —
account.proxyPoolHint: Both download paths of the same account share one proxy config to avoid single IP rate limiting

batchDownload.title: Batch Download
batchDownload.cookiePlaceholder: Leave empty to use global config; fill in path accessible by monitor service
batchDownload.cookieHint: Cookie override must be a file path accessible by the monitor server, cannot read browser local files directly.
batchDownload.recentHint: Can recover running tasks, or view completed/cancelled task results.

apiKeys.title: API Key Management
apiKeys.hint: Each key can have independent daily quota limit. Accounts can choose which key to use. If not specified, system default key is used automatically.

proxyPools.title: 代理池管理
proxyPools.nodeNamePlaceholder: 例如：香港节点-01 / 住宅代理
proxyPools.proxyHint: 支持带用户名密码认证的代理，认证信息已加密存储
proxyPools.enableNowHint: 保存后可在账户中关联使用
proxyPools.name: 池名称

dynProviders.title: 动态代理提供方
dynProviders.emptyTitle: 还没有配置动态代理提供方
dynProviders.emptyDesc: 添加一个提供方后，它将参与系统动态代理路由决策。付费提供方优先，免费提供方兜底。
dynProviders.addFirstNote: 提供方按优先级从低到高依次尝试
dynProviders.workbenchDesc: 仅管理列表拉取型提供方的 refresh / cleanup / run-once，不影响监控账户扫描事件。Provider Scheduler 不会随页面打开自动启动，需点击「启动动态代理调度」。
dynProviders.execHint: 独立于 monitor_events · 展开后筛选
dynProviders.providerNamePlaceholder: 例如：ProxyMesh 住宅代理 / 免费ProxyAPI
dynProviders.priority: 优先级（数字越小越优先）
dynProviders.localProxyUrlHint: 填写本地运行的代理服务地址（如 Clash、v2ray 等）
dynProviders.genericJson: 通用 JSON（GET + 结果路径/字段映射）
dynProviders.listAdapterHint: Geonode 官方接口请选择「Geonode」；其它 JSON 接口可留空并配置结果路径。
dynProviders.supportsAutoDlDesc: 参与自动下载时的代理路由
dynProviders.supportsCookieDesc: 可用于需要登录态的下载
dynProviders.supportsCountryDesc: 可指定出口 IP 的地理位置
dynProviders.supportsStickyDesc: 同一 IP 保持一段时间（推荐开启）
dynProviders.notesPlaceholder: 可选，如服务地址、账号信息等
